summary: A Meta AI staff member announces release of an open-weight 30B parameter agentic model, 'muse glimmer,' under Apache 2.0 that runs on 24GB VRAM, and previews a future open-weight release of 'muse spark 1.2'.

mechanisms.reason: A 30B agentic model that runs on 24GB of consumer-grade VRAM without losing reliability shifts some inference capability toward PC-class hardware rather than requiring datacentre GPUs.
mechanisms.quote: muse glimmer can run on 24GB of VRAM without losing agentic reliability

practices.reason: A concrete, downloadable open-weight agentic model with a stated VRAM footprint gives engineers a self-hostable option for agentic workloads at lower hardware cost than typical frontier models.
practices.quote: we also are releasing muse glimmer, a 30B agentic model with open weights under apache 2.0. muse glimmer can run on 24GB of VRAM without losing agentic reliability.
